name: roma
description:
Roma gives your AI chat a place to keep things. Ask it to save a plan as a note, add tasks to a list, or fill a list of books, contacts or expenses, and it is still there tomorrow, in this chat or any other. Start a conversation and it can see where you are: what's due today, what you're working on, recent notes, your lists, and what you asked Roma to remember about you.

What you can do:
- Get an overview of your workspace and what's due
- Search, read, create and update your tasks, notes and the lists you keep
- Add many items to a list at once, for example books, contacts or expenses
- See your Roma automations, read what they found, and run one on request
- Read and update your experts, the standing instructions you wrote, and work under one
- Delete into a 30-day trash and restore, and undo an edit from the version history

Roma only ever acts as you, on your own workspace. Your chat asks before anything changes. You need a Roma account (roma.app).

defaultPrompt: What's on my plate today in Roma?
What did I write down about the landlord and the deposit?
Save the packing list we just made as a note in Roma.

positive.description: Overview of the day from the workspace
positive.prompt: What's on my plate today in Roma?
positive.expected_behavior: A short summary of overdue and due-today tasks and anything in progress, using the user's own task titles.

positive.description: Recall a saved note by topic
positive.prompt: What did I write down about the landlord and the deposit?
positive.expected_behavior: The relevant content from the user's own note, naming the note it came from.

positive.description: Capture a plan from the conversation as a note
positive.prompt: Save the packing list we just made as a note in Roma.
positive.expected_behavior: A new note on the Notes list containing the packing list, confirmed with its title.

positive.description: Bulk-add items to an existing list
positive.prompt: Add Pachinko, The Three-Body Problem and Lessons in Chemistry to my reading list.
positive.expected_behavior: Three new items on the user's reading list, one per book, confirmed.

positive.prompt: What did my morning briefing automation report today?
positive.expected_behavior: The message the most recent run of the morning briefing left, with when it ran.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the user's workspace
Writing help that does not ask to save anything
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound more friendly: 'Your request has been received.'

negative.description: A to-do request for a different app the user named

publication.release_notes: 2.4.7: the skill says that a reply on a task already given back is just answered, that agents sharing one sign-in state their name on every write, and what the person does after a refused hand-off; the skill is short, the standing rule and the work rules, with the full text beside it (skill-full.md, roma.app/skill-full.md); the first-time setup follows the agents guide (roma.app/agents.md, its rules page and the ChatGPT page) in four steps, the standing line offered last as an option; 41 tools (the changes at roma.app/developers/changelog); OAuth sign-in unchanged.
